'''Ratoog''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was a member of the [[Friends of Paran]], an anti-Imperial resistance group, and he served the organization as a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and [[Computer/Legends|computer]] specialist. Ratoog wore a [[linguibox]] on his belt, which translated his speech from [[Gamorrean (language)|Gamorrean]] to [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]. He was also a successful [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] player.
